fusions.name: Scrape the Leavings
fusions.desc: Rakes a target at or below 30% health, a threshold that rises with each rank, consuming every affliction on it to deal 18 damage plus 1.2 times their remaining damage, with a 50% chance to leave it [Sundered] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Tine Drag
fusions.desc: Drags the tines through a cone 3 tiles ahead, dealing 4 damage, with a 25% chance to leave each target [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Patched From Scraps
fusions.desc: Rakes up scrap to patch your plate, gaining a barrier that absorbs the next 3 hits, up to 18 damage, for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Pick Over the Fallen
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you gain a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
